scientific.integrity: The primary full PDF was inspected at the stochastic diffusion model, logarithmic transformation, linearization, Fokker-Planck equation, stationary Gaussian density, Theorem 3.1, and the numerical parameter set. The relevant derivation pages were visually inspected. A related primary density-function article was checked for broader methodological context; its full text was access-restricted, so only its publisher abstract and bibliographic record were used. The bundled symbolic checker independently verifies the Itô correction, affine stationary moments, covariance, Jacobian, and source-parameter specialization. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The correction is exact for the local affine approximation obtained from the source's stochastic chemostat, but it is not claimed to be an exact stationary distribution of the nonlinear SDE. The corrected affine formulas retain the source's qualitative increase of normalized variance and skewness with noise.

title: Theorem 3.1 is not the pushforward stationary density of the linearized stochastic chemostat
